propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate designed an eight-week side-by-side trial in 12 stores in which planners kept ordering from the existing system.
propositions.rationale: The resume describes the trial design and the reference check confirms it in writing.

propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate built a LightGBM forecast for 900 fresh-produce lines at store-day level from two years of till data.
propositions.rationale: The resume describes the model directly.

propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate put the fresh-produce forecast into production in the replenishment system for all 180 stores from week 32 and monitored its accuracy.
propositions.rationale: The rollout line in the readout is a plan subject to board approval, and the trial sources say orders came from the existing system throughout; no source says the model drove replenishment in production. The deployment rule forbids describing a trial as production use.

expectedGap: Only the side-by-side trial is documented; production use in a replenishment system and post-release accuracy monitoring are not.
expectedBoundaryNote: Keep the forecast model and the 12-store side-by-side trial as documented; keep the rollout line as a plan subject to board approval.
permittedFollowUpTargets: Ask whether the supply-chain board approved the rollout, whether the model ever placed replenishment orders in production, and who monitored its accuracy afterwards.
